notes.title: Dev_Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
We've been a bit quiet the past few months, but that's 'cause we've been cooking! Let's catch you up to speed.
What's changed? 
This (Bl)Oc(k)tober will be the 2 year anniversary of the GameJam in which Block_Up was born. A lot of things have changed since then. Look at that glowup!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44540361/cb7ad50abb8c86e5ff8232314309229b895bce13.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44540361/e152f2449a01ca772e06af0a49a882a86e755249.png

Apart from the visual update, we've also added a bunch more block types for you to break and place as you please, controller support for most things, tons of small QoL changes, as well as a fancy level editor! We look forward to seeing all the blocktastic levels you come up with. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44540361/b24e1630beac4b9725893b4b1fa9a2114aff8dd6.png

Why's the blocking game not released yet?! 
Whilst the core game itself is basically done, a lot of the stuff around the game isn't yet - the biggest and most important being online multiplayer. But trust us when we say the game will be out as soon as it's ready - we want you to be able to play it too!

You mentioned Blocktober? 
Oh yeah! To celebrate, we'll be holding a small event on our Discord in October. Don't forget to join it to stay updated - be there and be square! There may even be free keys to be won...

Until then, we'll return to our blocky game-making cave. Until next time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44540361/234679a7d2342777d396c347f80fd95f298a568b.png
